main_measure.name: OLS slope of next-day excess return on forecast
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 (with supporting check) confirms; t <= -2 rejects; between is inconclusive

supporting_check.name: mean next-day excess return in forecast direction, top third |forecast|

reading: In-position bars are bars with a non-zero postRebalance_current_allocation and a next-day return in the same window; the top third is the n//3 largest |forecast| among them; the slope is OLS with an intercept on non-zero-forecast bars, its t from day-clustered (sandwich, G/(G-1)*(n-1)/(n-2)) standard errors; the coin's mean daily return uses all its in-window close-to-close returns.
decided_by: The slope's t is 2 or more and the top-third mean directional excess return is above 0.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0001479 on the check folds against +0.0003483 on every fold
